notes:
## New features & enhancements

- On Windows, the update dot now breathes slowly while a new version has been published but not yet downloaded, and switches to its usual blink once the download is in place and a restart will apply it.
- The radio's browser profiles are much smaller: caches capped at 4 MB, compiled graphics shaders no longer kept on disk, and Firefox's Safe Browsing and certificate-revocation lists turned off and removed. The installer clears what is already there.
- Enhancements to seasonal themes.

## Bug fixes

- The "Updated to" announcement always shows all five blinks and its pause before the station name returns. On a PC busy starting up it was cut short, or the station name came back over the last blink.
- Fixes in seasonal themes.
